text:
Marta Li: Quick thread — post-launch 1.0 follow-up. We have two small regressions flagged by customers and a handful of UX asks. Need to pick what goes in the 2-week mini-release. thoughts? :thinking_face:
Devin Park: Can we do a short intake? list each candidate, customer impact, risk, rough dev estimate. then we pick P0/P1/P2 for the mini-release.
Kai Nguyen: OK. My quick list: 1) Streaming prefix crash (AcmeHealth reported) - reproducible - 2 dev-days, high impact; 2) Metrics flush missing for short-lived sessions - intermittent - 1.5 dev-days; 3) Onboarding copy + CTA alignment - low impact - 0.5 dev-day.
Andrea Gomez: +1 to Kai's list. Also adding: 4) Model fallback routing sometimes hits a slower variant instead of fallback - observed in EU region - 3 dev-days, medium risk to latency SLAs.
Samir Patel: I think we should treat crash (1) as P0. Metrics flush (2) feels P1 unless we see data loss at customer side. Onboarding copy (3) P2 for sure. Fallback routing (4) could be P1 if it's causing customer errors.
Marta Li: Criteria from product side: P0 = customer-facing regression causing errors or data loss; P1 = noticeable degradation (latency, incorrect output) or high customer friction; P2 = polish/UX. Also consider rollout complexity (canary vs full).
Devin Park: Suggest we add estimated QA + rollout overhead: add 1 dev-day per item for QA & canary. so total for crash ~3 days. If we scope to 2-week sprint, we can do P0 + one P1 comfortably.
Kai Nguyen: For crash PR, I already have a branch. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1289 — includes a small guard and unit test. Needs pair QA for streaming tests.
Andrea Gomez: @Kai can you add a short regression test case to the canary checklist? Here's a snippet we use for streaming smoke: ```bash
curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -d '{"prompt":"stream test","stream":true}' \n  https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate
```
Kai Nguyen: Yep will add that to PR and to the staging canary steps.
deploy-bot: Canary deployed to staging (canary-17). Link: https://staging.redwood.dev/canary/17
Samir Patel: Ops note: keep an eye on token billing spike if we increase canary volume. Put a short probe to track per-token consumption.
Marta Li: Decision proposal: mini-release (two weeks) = include 1) Streaming prefix crash (P0) | owner: Kai | target: M-1 (first week) 2) Metrics flush (P1) | owner: Devin | target: M-2 (second week) 3) Onboarding copy (P2) | owner: Andrea | can be optional if bandwidth. Fallback routing defers unless more customer incidents pop up. Agree?
Devin Park: Agree. I'll pick up metrics flush and add QA checklist.
Andrea Gomez: Agree to owners and targets. I'll handle onboarding copy and coordinate with design.
Kai Nguyen: Starting work now, will request review tomorrow.
Marta Li: I'll update the roadmap board and create the mini-release milestone: milestone/mini-rel-2026-03. Please add estimates to each ticket.
Devin Park: Added estimates to tickets and linked PRs.
Samir Patel: I'll add the canary watch and a quick alert for token surge.
Marta Li: Great — meeting-free decision. If anything blocks, call a 15m sync. :thumbsup:
